+title: Public-surface diff probe for completeness
+---
+A TreeSitterProbe that reports what a diff did to the public surface of each changed file.
+
+- Parse the before and after versions. Compare public symbols: added, removed, signature changed, visibility changed.
+- Reuse the entity-level semantic diff machinery behind the git `get diff` op. Do not write a second symbol differ.
+- One ProbeRow per surface change: symbol path, change kind, old and new signature.
+
+Wire-up:
+- Add the probe to the `completeness` set's `probes:` list.
+- Update the completeness rule prompts to consume the rows as computed facts — same style as cognitive-complexity: the changes are computed for you, judge them, do not re-derive them.
+
+Acceptance:
+- A diff that changes one public signature yields exactly that row.
+- A diff with no public-surface change yields no rows, and the prompt treats that as a measurement.
+
+#tool-validators
\ No newline at end of file

 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01kzdrcz5pqb1ry7g1rfj7pz0h
+  text: |-
+    Research done. Picked up ^58n25xs, moved to doing.
+
+    Findings:
+    - The entity-level semantic differ behind git `get diff` is `swissarmyhammer_sem::model::identity::match_entities(before, after, path, sim_fn, sha, author) -> MatchResult { changes: Vec<SemanticChange> }`. The MCP `get diff` file mode calls it directly (crates/swissarmyhammer-tools/src/mcp/tools/git/diff/mod.rs). `compute_semantic_diff` is the same matcher plus re-parsing, which a probe must not do. So the probe reuses `match_entities`.
+    - `SemanticEntity` carries NO visibility and NO signature. Only `metadata: Option<HashMap<..>>`, which the tree-sitter extractor always leaves `None`. So visibility and signature must be read off the parse.
+    - `match_entities` reports Renamed/Moved with the AFTER entity id only, so a join keyed on `entity_id` alone loses the before side. The before entity list is available beside the changes, so the join is done where both are in hand.
+
+    Design (mirrors `test_census`, which is the sibling probe's precedent):
+    - swissarmyhammer-sem `parser/plugins/code/public_surface.rs`: a `SurfaceSpec` roster, one row per language, saying how the language spells "reachable from outside the file" and where a declaration's body starts. A language with no row returns `None` = not computed, never an empty result.
+    - `ParsedCode::public_surface(file_path, source) -> Option<PublicSurface>`; `PublicSurface::changes_from(&before) -> Vec<SurfaceChange>` runs `match_entities` inside. The probe writes NO differ.
+    - `entity_extractor` gains `extract_entity_nodes`, one walk producing each entity WITH its node, so `entities()` and the surface reader share one traversal.
+    - Probe `public-surface` in tree_sitter_probes.rs, `ProbeKind::Fact`, registered in `TREE_SITTER_PROBES`.
+    - Wire-up: `probes: [inverse-pairs, public-surface]` in the completeness set, and the completeness rule prompts consume the rows as computed facts.
+  timestamp: 2026-08-07T09:20:51.894320+00:00

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01kzdsc6mjsen0qd3qw5z7kg7k
+  text: |-
+    Implementation landed.
+
+    What was built:
+    - `crates/swissarmyhammer-sem/src/parser/plugins/code/public_surface.rs` (new). `SURFACE_SPECS` is the visibility roster — one row per language saying how it spells "this declaration reaches outside its file". Four rule families: a modifier keyword (Rust `pub`, Java `public`/`protected`), an `export` ancestor (JavaScript/TypeScript/TSX), an initial capital (Go), a leading underscore (Python). Rust `pub(self)` is told apart from `pub(crate)`/`pub(super)` by the word inside the brackets. Unmapped languages return `None` = not measured, never an empty surface.
+    - `PublicSurface::changes_from` runs `match_entities`, the differ behind git `get diff`. The probe writes no differ. A renamed symbol is reported under the id it carries under review only, so the base side is found by the content the differ recorded for it.
+    - `entity_extractor::extract_entity_nodes` — one traversal yielding each entity WITH its node. `extract_entities` is now a thin map over it, so the entity walk and the surface walk cannot disagree.
+    - `public-surface` probe in tree_sitter_probes.rs, `ProbeKind::Fact`, sealed, registered in `TREE_SITTER_PROBES`. Two not-computed details: no base revision, and no visibility mapping.
+    - Wire-up: `probes: [inverse-pairs, public-surface]` on the completeness set; `public-output-contract` gained a "What the probe gives you" section, a check 6 for a removed/re-signed/hidden declaration, and two exceptions.
+
+    Discoveries worth keeping:
+    - `builtin::tests::test_completeness_declares_the_inverse_pairs_probe_its_rule_reads` asserted the probe list EXACTLY. It is now a table (`COMPLETENESS_PROBE_READERS`) pairing each declared probe with the rule that reads it, so declaring a probe and reading it stay one edit.
+    - The signature is the declaration text up to its `body` field. Every mapped grammar uses that one field name. A declaration with no body (a Rust constant) is its own first line.
+    - A field added to a public struct's body is NOT a surface change here: the struct's declaration head is unchanged and the fields are not separate entities. Documented, not fixed.
+    - Visibility is read at the declaration and never through its parents, so a `pub` function inside a private module reads as public. Documented.
+    - Go `type_declaration` produces no entity at all (`extract_name` fails on it), a pre-existing extractor gap, so Go types never reach the surface.
+
+    Verification:
+    - RED first: the five acceptance tests failed with "unknown probe 'public-surface'".
+    - The roster tests were proved to bite by removing the non-Rust rows (5 tests RED) and by clearing Rust's `private_words` (the `pub(self)` test RED). Both restored.
+    - `cargo test -p swissarmyhammer-sem -p swissarmyhammer-validators` — 348 + 490 + 4 doc tests, 0 failed.
+    - `cargo clippy -p swissarmyhammer-sem -p swissarmyhammer-validators --all-targets -- -D warnings` clean; `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` clean; `cargo test -p swissarmyhammer-tools --lib mcp::tools::git` 46 passed (the differ's other caller).
+    - `check validators` ok, 14 validators, 0 errors.
+
+    ### implement — changed
+    - evidence: 7 files — crates/swissarmyhammer-sem/src/parser/plugins/code/public_surface.rs (new), crates/swissarmyhammer-sem/src/parser/plugins/code/entity_extractor.rs, crates/swissarmyhammer-sem/src/parser/plugins/code/mod.rs, crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/review/tree_sitter_probes.rs, crates/swissarmyhammer-validators/src/builtin/mod.rs, builtin/validators/completeness/VALIDATOR.md, builtin/validators/completeness/rules/public-output-contract.md
+    - next: /review
